resources.string: A Genesis Node card\'s live status: green running, red not running, yellow being slashed, gray cooling down.
Which Genesis Node card should this widget show?
Enter a card number from 1 to 2500

Add a widget: long-press an empty spot on your home screen → Widgets → Delphi Nodes → drag \"Delphi Node\" onto the screen, then enter the card number. Add one widget per card.\n\nColors: green running · red not running or not staked · yellow being slashed · gray cooling down. Widgets refresh about once a minute while your screen is on; tap one to open its card.
Copy link for your wallet\'s browser
…or paste the approval code from delphi.site

Runs your card\'s node in the background, even with the screen off, and keeps the widget green. Your wallet approves this phone once, for one card, for 7 days; the approval can only sign that card\'s node reports. Pauses below 30 % battery unless charging. Keep battery use "Unrestricted" for this app.
